scope: News articles only; directory profiles, category/index pages and refreshes excluded
verification: All 100 new paths absent from baseline and present in live News archive
All 100 return HTTP 200 and their article-body HTML matches local production content
Canonical URLs, institutional NewsArticle author, publication dates, source links, text-only bodies, robots meta/header and global robots checks passed
All 100 included in reachable, XML-parseable main and News sitemaps
Each addition contains 500–700 words excluding tags and generated directory context; all 100 body hashes differ
Headlines/intents and closest related coverage reviewed across all 485 archive pages; targeted body comparisons confirm distinctions for overlapping categories
semantic_method: TF-IDF similarity was used only to find related coverage for editorial review, not as an automatic proof of originality. The 19 older article-content layouts were included alongside article-body layouts. Named-business profiles cover distinct operators, operating formats and practical information; service guides compare distinct purchase, service or activity intents.

semantic_review_examples.romance_vs_general_bookstores: Genre-specific stores, purchasing formats and book clubs differ from the earlier general-store itinerary; different shops.

semantic_review_examples.fireplace_vs_chimney: New products, showroom consultation and installation quotes differ from sweeping and inspections.
semantic_review_examples.piano_showroom_vs_tuning: Instrument shopping, rotating inventory, rentals and purchase terms differ from maintenance appointments.

search_console.news_search_type: Google Search News tab; not Google News app/site
search_console.interpretation: Tiny sample, no defensible trend or broad inclusion claim. Private raw exports were not committed. Existing daily/weekly cadence continues.
search_console.web_baseline: Separate Web export, 2026-09-13 through 2026-10-10; 1116 clicks and 66194 impressions; historical aggregate average position 8.7, not a current rank.
